title: World's Finest Comics
detail: Golden Age (1941-1947) issues are true ANTHOLOGY books — each issue has multiple unrelated stories by different writer/artist teams (e.g. Bill Finger/Bob Kane on Batman, Siegel/Shuster on Superman, George Papp on Green Arrow, all within the same issue). There is no single 'Writer' or 'Artist' for the whole book. Cannot fill with one name without misrepresenting the book. Needs a decision: either leave blank, or pick a 'primary feature' convention (e.g. credit the Batman story only) and document that rule.

title: The Flash
detail: Initial search targeted 1987 Messner-Loebs run based on assumed era, but actual rows in inventory (15 rows, all tagged Volume=1) span 2016-2018 (Rebirth) and 2023-2024 (Williamson/Adams later run), plus 2 anomalous Legacy-numbered entries (#783, #802) that don't fit either era. Volume=1 label is WRONG for all of these — none are the true Vol 1 (1959-1985) or even Vol 2 (1987-2009). This is a volume-mislabeling issue, not a simple missing-writer gap. Stopped before applying wrong data. Needs separate targeted research per actual year-cluster (2016-18 vs 2023-24 vs the 2 outliers) plus a Volume correction pass.
